retention.body: Messages are kept for as long as the request needs, then deleted after thirty-six months at the latest.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may access, correct and delete your data. To do so, write to {email}.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The website keeps the theme preference in the local storage of the browser. If you pick a language other than your browser's, a cookie remembers it until the browser closes. When audience measurement is enabled, analytics cookies are only set after you give consent through the banner shown at the bottom of the page. You can change your mind at any time from the "Cookie preferences" link in the footer. If you display the appointment calendar, you voluntarily load a third-party service (Calendly), which may set its own cookies.
